_meta.description: ScholarPilot seed catalog. Each entry must be verified against its official page by a human reviewer before it is marked verified.

eligibility_fields.age_reference: {month, day, years_after_deadline}: the date on which age is measured; omit to use the deadline
eligibility_fields.min_grade_percent: school leavers: minimum HSSC / A-Level equivalent percentage
eligibility_fields.min_cgpa_percent: graduates: minimum CGPA as a percentage of the scale
eligibility_fields.max_years_since_graduation: degree must not be older than this
eligibility_fields.requires_financial_need: true if the award is need-based
eligibility_fields.other: conditions the engine cannot check automatically

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS - Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
scholarships.funding_details: Monthly DAAD stipend, health insurance, travel allowance and study/research subsidy. Tuition at German public universities is free or very low.

english.note: Language requirement is set by each EPOS course; some courses need IELTS 6.5 or German.

other: Bachelor's degree in a subject related to the chosen course
At least two years of relevant professional experience at the time of application
Applications go directly to the chosen EPOS course, not to DAAD

deadline.note: Each course sets its own deadline; most fall between August and October for the following year's intake.

documents: Motivation letter linked to your work
steps: Pick 1-3 EPOS courses from the DAAD scholarship database
Check each course's own deadline and language requirement
Prepare documents and get degree/transcripts attested by HEC
Apply directly to the course using its DAAD application form
Shortlisted candidates may be interviewed; DAAD makes the final selection

scholarships.name: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (Public Policy and Good Governance)
scholarships.funding_details: Monthly stipend, health insurance, travel allowance and a German language course before the master's.

english.note: Some partner master's programmes accept IELTS 6.0; check the course.

other: Bachelor's degree in law, economics, political or social sciences, or public administration
Work experience is an advantage
Commitment to working in the public sector in Pakistan

deadline.note: Usually closes in summer for the intake starting the following year.

steps: Choose up to three partner master's programmes
Apply through the DAAD portal before the deadline
Interview in Pakistan if shortlisted
German language course before starting

scholarships.name: Deutschlandstipendium
scholarships.provider: German Federal Ministry of Education and Research with partner universities
scholarships.funding_details: A fixed monthly amount for at least two semesters, regardless of income. It does not cover full living costs.

english.note: Language is set by your degree programme.

other: You must be admitted to or enrolled at a participating German university
Selection on grades, social commitment and personal circumstances

deadline.note: Each university runs its own call, usually once a year.

steps: Get admission to a participating German university
Watch your university's scholarship page for the call
Apply through the university

english.note: Language is set by your degree programme.

other: You must be admitted to or enrolled at a participating German university

deadline.note: Each university runs its own call.

steps: Get admission to a participating German university
Apply through the university's scholarship office

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition, monthly living allowance, return flights and arrival/departure allowances for a one-year master's in the UK.

english.note: Chevening no longer sets its own English requirement, but your UK university will.

other: At least 2,800 hours (about two years) of work experience
An undergraduate degree that gets you into a UK postgraduate course
Apply to three eligible UK master's courses
Return to Pakistan for at least two years after the award
Have not previously studied in the UK on UK government funding

deadline.note: Applications usually open in August and close in early October.

documents: Online application with four essays (leadership, networking, studying in the UK, career plan)
Unconditional offer from a UK university (by the July deadline)
steps: Shortlist three UK master's courses
Write the four Chevening essays
Submit the online application before the deadline
Interview at the British High Commission if shortlisted (around February-March)
Secure an unconditional university offer by July

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition, airfare, monthly stipend and other allowances.

english.note: Required by the UK university; scores vary by course.

other: First degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) standard or equivalent
Unable to afford UK study without the scholarship
Must be nominated by HEC Pakistan; HEC sets an earlier national deadline

deadline.note: The CSC deadline is usually mid-October; the HEC nomination deadline comes earlier.

steps: Watch HEC's call for Commonwealth nominations
Apply to HEC as the nominating agency
Complete the CSC online application
Apply to up to three UK universities

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships
scholarships.funding_details: A tuition fee contribution (around GBP 10,000) for a one-year postgraduate taught course.

other: Offer for an eligible one-year master's at a participating university
Classed as an international (overseas) fee payer

deadline.note: Each university sets its own deadline, mostly in spring.

steps: Check which universities offer GREAT scholarships to Pakistan this year
Apply for the course
Apply for the scholarship through the university

scholarships.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition waiver, monthly stipend, accommodation contribution and medical insurance.

english.note: Universities set the score; some accept their own test or an interview.

other: Completed (or completing) HSSC / A-Levels before the course starts
Nominated by HEC Pakistan after applying online

deadline.note: The online application usually closes in mid-January.

steps: Choose up to two programmes on the application portal
Submit online by the January deadline
HEC reviews and nominates
University entrance exam / interview
Final results usually in spring

other: Bachelor's degree completed before the course starts
Nominated by HEC Pakistan

deadline.note: The online application usually closes in mid-January.

steps: Choose up to two programmes
Submit online by the January deadline
HEC nomination
University interview
Results in spring

scholarships.name: Italian Government (MAECI) Scholarships for Foreign Students
scholarships.provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
scholarships.funding_details: A monthly allowance and a tuition fee exemption for the academic year. Check the yearly call for current amounts.

english.note: Depends on the course language (English or Italian).

other: Age limit is set in each year's call; check before applying
Admission to an Italian university master's programme

deadline.note: The call is usually published in spring.

steps: Pre-enroll through Universitaly
Apply on the Study in Italy portal when the call opens
Wait for the published results

scholarships.name: Italian Regional Right-to-Study (DSU) Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Italian regional agencies (e.g. Lazio DiSCo, EDISU Piemonte, ER.GO)
scholarships.funding_details: Need-based: a yearly cash grant, tuition exemption, and in many regions free meals or a place in student housing.

other: Family income and assets below the regional threshold (proven with ISEE-equivalent documents translated and legalized)
Admission to a university in that region

deadline.note: Each region publishes its own call, usually July to September.

documents: Translations and legalization by the Italian embassy
steps: Get admission to an Italian university
Collect family income documents early (legalization takes weeks)
Apply on the regional DSU agency's portal
Check the provisional ranking

other: Family income and assets below the regional threshold
Admission to a university in that region

deadline.note: Each region publishes its own call.

steps: Get admission
Prepare legalized family documents
Apply on the regional DSU portal

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarships
scholarships.funding_details: Monthly allowance, tuition and participation costs, travel and insurance, for joint master's programmes taught in two or more European countries.

english.note: Each programme sets its own score.

other: Bachelor's degree (or final year)
Have not already received an Erasmus Mundus master's scholarship
Apply directly to each programme's consortium

deadline.note: Most programmes close between October and February.

steps: Browse the EACEA Erasmus Mundus catalogue
Shortlist programmes (you may apply to up to three)
Apply on each programme's own website before its deadline

scholarships.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship - Undergraduate (Embassy Recommendation)
scholarships.provider: Japanese Ministry of Education (MEXT) through the Embassy of Japan in Pakistan
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition, monthly stipend and return airfare, including a year of Japanese language preparation.

english.note: Selection includes the embassy's written exams (English, Mathematics, Science or Japanese) and an interview.

other: Completed 12 years of school education (HSSC / A-Levels)
Must be under 25 on 1 April of the year you arrive in Japan
Willing to learn Japanese

deadline.note: The embassy usually announces the call in April with a May deadline.

steps: Watch the Embassy of Japan in Pakistan website for the call
Submit documents to the embassy
Sit the written exams
Interview
Final MEXT selection

scholarships.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship - Research Student (Embassy Recommendation)
scholarships.provider: MEXT through the Embassy of Japan in Pakistan
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition, monthly stipend and airfare. You begin as a research student and can move into a master's programme.

english.note: The embassy runs English and Japanese tests; many supervisors also ask for IELTS/TOEFL.

other: Bachelor's degree (16 years of education)
Under 35 on 1 April of the year you arrive
A clear research plan; contacting a Japanese supervisor first is strongly recommended

deadline.note: The embassy usually announces the call in April.

documents: Field of study and research plan
steps: Contact potential supervisors in Japan
Apply to the embassy
Written test and interview
Get a letter of acceptance from a Japanese university
MEXT final selection

scholarships.name: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program
scholarships.provider: Asian Development Bank with participating institutions
scholarships.funding_details: Tuition, monthly subsistence and housing allowance, books, medical insurance and travel.

other: Bachelor's degree with a superior academic record
At least two years of full-time professional experience
Admission to a participating institution (in Japan or the Asia-Pacific)
Commit to returning home after study

deadline.note: Each participating institution sets its own deadline.

steps: Choose a participating institution and programme
Apply for admission and indicate ADB-JSP
The institution nominates candidates to ADB

scholarships.name: Australia Awards Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
scholarships.funding_details: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, contribution to living expenses and health cover.

english.note: Usually IELTS 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0.

other: Pakistan's participation changes over time; confirm it is on the current country list
Return home for at least two years after the award
Not married or engaged to an Australian/New Zealand citizen or permanent resident

deadline.note: Rounds usually open in February and close at the end of April.

steps: Confirm Pakistan is listed for the current round
Apply on OASIS
Shortlisting and interview
Placement at an Australian university

scholarships.name: Destination Australia Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Australian Department of Education with regional institutions
scholarships.funding_details: Up to AUD 15,000 per year towards study at a regional campus. It does not cover full tuition.

other: Study at an eligible regional campus
Apply through the institution's own scholarship process

steps: Find participating regional institutions
Apply for admission
Apply for the scholarship with the institution

other: Study at an eligible regional campus

steps: Find participating regional institutions
Apply for admission
Apply for the scholarship with the institution
